Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Data Engineer position. We will not move forward with your application, because your CV does not show the following required points:
- Knowledge of the general principles of Data Warehousing and Data Lakes
- Hands-on experience with SQL
- Knowledge of Python
- Experience with GCP or another cloud provider

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
